title: 剑雅16 Test2 听力早读
intro: 先读英文例句，再用中文提示复述；例句和完整段落为原文表达的迁移练习。

examples.en: I **tend to stay up late** when I’m under pressure.
examples.zh: 我压力大时往往会熬夜。

examples.en: Working from home **fits in with my lifestyle** because I prefer a flexible schedule.
examples.zh: 在家办公适合我的生活方式，因为我喜欢灵活的时间安排。

source.anchor: I struggled a bit with the action plan

examples.en: I used to **struggle with public speaking**, but I’m getting better at it.
examples.zh: 我以前觉得当众讲话很困难，但现在逐渐进步了。

examples.en: Having a quiet place to study **makes a big difference to my concentration**.
examples.zh: 有一个安静的学习环境，对我的专注力有很大帮助。

examples.en: I started learning the guitar **just for fun**.
examples.zh: 我最初学吉他纯粹是为了好玩。

oral.phrase: have a go at sth / doing sth

examples.en: I’d like to **have a go at painting**, even though I’m not particularly artistic.
examples.zh: 虽然我不太有艺术天赋，但我想尝试一下绘画。

oral.phrase: get bored with sth / doing sth

examples.en: I **get bored with doing the same workout** every day.
examples.zh: 每天做同样的锻炼，我会感到厌倦。

source.anchor: when it comes to physical fitness gains

examples.en: **When it comes to choosing a holiday destination**, I usually prefer somewhere quiet.
examples.zh: 选择度假目的地时，我通常更喜欢安静的地方。

examples.en: **Talking of exercise**, I’ve recently started swimming again.
examples.zh: 说到运动，我最近又开始游泳了。

examples.en: **I’d always assumed that cooking was difficult** until I started making meals myself.
examples.zh: 在开始自己做饭之前，我一直以为做饭很难。

source.anchor: it’s meant to make you more creative

examples.en: This app **is meant to help me manage my time**, but I rarely use it.
examples.zh: 这个应用本来是用来帮我管理时间的，但我很少使用它。

source.anchor: have a look through the photos

examples.en: I usually **have a look through my notes** before class.
examples.zh: 我通常会在上课前翻看一下笔记。

oral.phrase: Can you give me an idea of …?

source.anchor: give me an idea of how much this will cost

examples.en: **Can you give me an idea of how much the course costs?**
examples.zh: 你能大致告诉我这门课需要多少钱吗？

source.anchor: convert it into a tourist information centre

examples.en: Unused offices could be **converted into affordable housing**.
examples.zh: 闲置的办公楼可以改造成价格可负担的住房。

collocations.phrase: due to a lack of funding

examples.en: The project was delayed **due to a lack of funding**.
examples.zh: 该项目由于缺乏资金而延期了。

examples.en: Trains are often **full to capacity** during rush hour.
examples.zh: 高峰时段，列车经常满员。

source.anchor: cater particularly for the many pupils

examples.en: Public libraries should **cater for people of different ages**.
examples.zh: 公共图书馆应满足不同年龄人群的需要。

source.anchor: the smooth running of the Food Hall

examples.en: Clear rules help ensure **the smooth running of a school**.
examples.zh: 清晰的规章制度有助于确保学校顺利运作。

examples.en: Researchers need to select **the most appropriate methodology** for their study.
examples.zh: 研究人员需要为研究选择最合适的方法。

examples.en: The results did not **show any obvious patterns**.
examples.zh: 研究结果没有呈现出明显的规律。

collocations.phrase: the correlation between A and B

source.anchor: the correlation between our two variables

examples.en: The study examined **the correlation between screen time and sleep duration**.
examples.zh: 这项研究考察了屏幕使用时间与睡眠时长之间的相关性。

collocations.meaning: 给某人施加不必要的压力

examples.en: Excessive testing may **put students under unnecessary stress**.
examples.zh: 过于频繁的测试可能会给学生施加不必要的压力。

examples.en: Community activities can **be especially beneficial for older adults**.
examples.zh: 社区活动对老年人尤其有益。

examples.en: Better street lighting may **lower the risk of accidents**.
examples.zh: 改善街道照明可能降低事故风险。

examples.en: High fees can create **barriers to participation** in sports.
examples.zh: 高昂的费用可能成为参与体育活动的障碍。

examples.en: Regular revision helps students **retain information**.
examples.zh: 定期复习有助于学生记住信息。

collocations.meaning: 幸福感；身心良好的感受

examples.en: A supportive environment can improve students’ **sense of well-being**.
examples.zh: 一个能够提供支持的环境可以提升学生的幸福感。

source.anchor: reduce older people’s sense of isolation

examples.en: Local clubs may help **reduce older people’s sense of isolation**.
examples.zh: 当地的俱乐部可能有助于减轻老年人的孤独感。

examples.en: Shared spaces can **encourage interaction among residents**.
examples.zh: 共享空间可以促进居民之间的交流。

collocations.phrase: have greater motivation to do sth

source.anchor: having greater motivation to be more active

examples.en: Students may **have greater motivation to learn** when they can choose topics they enjoy.
examples.zh: 当学生可以选择自己喜欢的话题时，他们可能更有学习动力。

patterns.phrase: One thing I hadn’t realised … was that …
patterns.meaning: 在……之前，我没有意识到的一点是……

source.anchor: One thing I hadn’t realised before researching this topic was that

examples.en: **One thing I hadn’t realised before living alone was that** managing a household takes a lot of time.
examples.zh: 独自生活之前，我没有意识到打理一个家需要花很多时间。

patterns.phrase: have / get + 宾语 + 过去分词
patterns.meaning: 安排某事被处理；使某事完成。

source.anchor: get them converted to digital format

examples.en: I need to **get my laptop repaired** before the new term starts.
examples.zh: 我需要在新学期开始前把笔记本电脑修好。

examples.en: The school **had its library renovated** last year.
examples.zh: 学校去年安排翻新了图书馆。

patterns.phrase: What I find particularly … about … is that …

source.anchor: what’s only been discovered recently is that

examples.en: **What I find particularly useful about online courses is that** I can learn at my own pace.
examples.zh: 我觉得在线课程特别实用的一点是，我可以按照自己的节奏学习。

patterns.phrase: For every … that …, there are / may be … that …
patterns.meaning: 每有一个……，就有／可能还有……

source.anchor: for each dream that comes true, we have thousands that don’t

examples.en: **For every successful project that receives public attention, there may be** many unsuccessful ones that go unnoticed.
examples.zh: 每有一个受到公众关注的成功项目，就可能还有许多失败的项目无人注意。

patterns.phrase: There is evidence to suggest that …

source.anchor: there’s plenty of evidence which suggests that

examples.en: **There is evidence to suggest that** dancing may lower the risk of falls by helping people improve their balance.
examples.zh: 有证据提示，跳舞可能通过帮助人们改善平衡能力，降低跌倒的风险。

examples.en: Group projects involve discussion, cooperation and shared responsibilities, **all of which can help students develop communication skills**.
examples.zh: 小组项目涉及讨论、合作和共同承担责任，这些都有助于学生培养沟通能力。

source.anchor: even those whose standard of fitness is quite low

examples.en: The course is open to everyone, **even those whose knowledge of the subject is limited**.
examples.zh: 这门课程向所有人开放，即使对这个领域了解有限的人也可以参加。

patterns.phrase: be likely to do / be more likely to do

source.anchor: is likely to keep on rising

examples.en: Demand for flexible working arrangements **is likely to increase**.
examples.zh: 对灵活工作安排的需求很可能会增加。

examples.en: People **are more likely to maintain a habit** if they enjoy the activity.
examples.zh: 如果人们喜欢一项活动，就更可能坚持这个习惯。

passages.label: 口语谈运动习惯
passages.en: **When it comes to exercise**, I prefer cycling. It **fits in with my lifestyle** because I can cycle to work. I started doing it **just for fun**, but it has **made a big difference to** the way I spend my weekends. Now I often go for a ride instead of staying at home.
passages.zh: 谈到运动，我更喜欢骑行。它适合我的生活方式，因为我可以骑车上班。最初我只是觉得好玩，但它大大改变了我度过周末的方式。现在我经常出去骑车，而不是待在家里。

passages.label: 写作说明社区活动的好处
passages.en: Community activities can **be especially beneficial for older adults**. By providing opportunities to meet regularly, they can **encourage interaction** and help **reduce a sense of isolation**.
passages.zh: 社区活动对老年人尤其有益。通过提供定期见面的机会，这些活动可以促进交流，并帮助减轻孤独感。

patterns.label: 句式3
patterns.body: 由原文 What’s only been discovered recently is that … 拓展而来。可以替换 useful 为 interesting、surprising、impressive，用来突出你对某件事的评价。

patterns.label: 句式4
patterns.body: 来自原文“一个成真的梦，对应许多没有成真的梦”的对照。适合提醒读者关注容易被忽略的情况；may be 是否需要，由你想表达的确定程度决定。

patterns.label: 句式5
patterns.body: 例句根据原文的舞蹈研究描述改写。There is evidence to suggest that 用来引出有依据的判断；by helping … 则进一步解释作用方式。

patterns.label: 句式7
patterns.body: 来自原文 even those whose standard of fitness is quite low。注意 whose 后接名词，这里的 whose knowledge 表示“这些人的知识”。

reading.label: on offer / on sale
reading.body: 本文中是“供应的／有售的”。

reading.label: eventually
reading.body: 最终；eventually we may … 中，“可能”来自 may。

reading.label: come about / come into use / come true
reading.body: 发生、实现／开始投入使用／成真。

reading.label: hardly … before …
reading.body: 本文强调午餐时间紧，学生可能才刚吃完，下午课就开始了。

boundaries.label: be meant to
boundaries.body: 原文中可以表示“据说能／按理应该”，带有预期意味。

boundaries.label: due to a lack of funding
boundaries.body: 是对原文 through lack of money 的迁移改写。

boundaries.label: have/get sth done
boundaries.body: 可以强调安排别人处理，也可以强调完成；get the photos packed up 可以是自己打包。

boundaries.label: correlation
boundaries.body: 表示相关性，不能直接当成因果关系。

boundaries.label: all of which
boundaries.body: 要让读者清楚知道它概括的是前面的哪些内容。
